name: Relative-Strength Momentum v1 (no RS filter)
description: Ablation of rs_momentum_v1: drops the rs_rank >= @rs_floor condition entirely so the same near-52w-high + volume + delivery setup is evaluated on the full halal universe, not just the top decile by 60-day relative strength. Used to measure how much the RS gate costs in trade count vs. what it buys in quality.
